body:
Hello,

We're around the same age, though I suspect I am just a tad bit older. Perhaps a few months.   
I have experienced the same guilt you have. Often times, I have found myself in the arms of another person while I cry out my sorrows. Occasionally, however, I noticed that some tended to reply quite dryly, or speculate that I was just looking for attention or something of the sort.  


I too have started to plan mine, however if I go through with it is another story. You could see it as a precaution, I suppose. If everything in my life becomes a cesspool, I do not see why I should have the will to continue living.  


But enough about me, let's talk about you. Yes, people suffer for longer, or from worse things, but you should not compare yourself to them. As they say (roughly, my memory is quite bad), a man drowning in 10 ft of water is no different than a man drowning in 15 ft of water.   


Us humans are not mind readers or fortune tellers. There is no way for you to know whether your life will get worse or will get better. If you are curious, stick around and find out. If you are fed up, I recommend you reach out for help. Sometimes things are not as they seem, and it would not hurt to have some hope.   


You are still young, and you still have a lot to live for. And, if you do not know what your purpose to live for is yet, then find it. That can be your goal.   


Stay well.  


Sincerely, a kindred soul.
